programme.title: Khwaja Mere Khwaja
programme.desc: The plot follows the downfall of the Quadri family due to betrayal and their subsequent pursuit of peace.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Mast

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Juaari

programme.title: Jaane Jigar

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Devta

Plus, clues are unravelled to Maya political intrigue in Guatemala.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S3 E1 — Wigan PierTony Robinson embarks on another expedition through some of Britain's most historic landscapes. He begins with a towpath exploration of industrial engineering along the Leeds and Liverpool Canal. Setting off from Liverpool, he takes a three-day walk inland to Wigan, ending at the town's iconic pier as he traces the story of the waterway's chaotic construction and its impact on the development of Lancashire.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S3 E2 — The Dark Age of NorthumbriaTony Robinson explores the history of the ancient kingdom on a walk from Melrose in the Scottish Borders to Holy Island off the coast of Northumberland. Over five days, he goes on the trail of one of Northumbria's greatest sons - Saint Cuthbert. Through the Tweed Valley and across the Cheviot Hills, it's a journey through a murky history laden with myth. However, by investigating the communities, power bases and landscape of seventh-century Northumbria, Tony aims to understand the pagan land in which Cuthbert spread his simple brand of Celtic Christianity.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: Aliens Vs Predator - Requiem
programme.desc: A spaceship crash results in the infestation of a small town by aliens, so a Predator is despatched to hunt them down - and any superfluous humans who happen to get in the way. However, an even bigger threat is lurking in the area, in the form of a terrifying hybrid of the two extraterrestrial creatures. Sci-fi action sequel, starring Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth and John Ortiz.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: The Avengers
programme.desc: A mystical artefact is stolen from a top-secret military base by Thor's brother Loki, who plans to use it to bring about an alien invasion. Spymaster Nick Fury brings together a team of superheroes, including Iron Man, Thor, Captain America and the Hulk, to defend Earth from the impending attack. Action adventure uniting the Marvel comic-book characters, starring Robert Downey Jr, Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Hiddleston, Jeremy Renner and Samuel L Jackson.

programme.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
programme.desc: An old man tells a journalist the story of his youth as a lobby boy at a hotel in Eastern Europe in the 1930s. He was taken under the wing of the establishment's dashing concierge, and is drawn into his misadventures as he becomes involved in a conflict over a valuable painting. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.desc: Aspiring fashion journalist Rebecca Bloomwood accepts a position writing for a financial magazine. As she sets the publishing world alight with her unique brand of consumer advice, Rebecca is forced to confront her own purchasing habits and begins to question whether rampant spending sprees are the way to true happiness. Comedy, starring Isla Fisher, Hugh Dancy, Krysten Ritter and Joan Cusack.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Single man Frank Adler attempts to raise his child prodigy niece, Mary. However, his plans for a normal school life for the youngster are foiled when the youngster's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn. Drama, starring Chris Evans, Lindsay Duncan and Mckenna Grace.

Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Tom `Westy' Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant `The Classroom' in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheriden formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish `The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist DonnaTaggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland will recreate their four course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There's also a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with stunning dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to Grime. programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios.They will be cooking for the judges food critic, Mathew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worth of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs must cook in an unfamiliar kitchen and scale up their dishes to provide the highest calibre of dining for a full banquet room of diners. Their guests are celebrities and unsung heroes who have helped create British music's unparalleled global reputation.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the nation's greatest chefs battle for the chance to cook a glittering Olympic banquet. The feast will honour the hopes and achievements of the country's sporting heroes, and it will be a glorious celebration of Britain's culinary talents. This time it is the battle of the Scottish chefs - returning contender Alan Murchison and newcomers Colin Buchan and Mark Greenaway.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Returning contender Alan Murchison and newcomers Colin Buchan and Mark Greenaway must cook their fish course, but which one will prevail? Will it be grilled mackerel with beetroot meringues and horseradish ice cream, crab `cannelloni' or poached halibut with squid ink? Great British Menu veteran Jeremy Lee will decide who goes through to the judges.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E18Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group C Winner v Group F Runner-UpGroup C winner v Group F runner-up (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Houston Stadium in the USA. Who tops Group C will have been decided by goal difference should Brazil and Morocco have defeated Scotland and Haiti respectively. It was the same situation in Group F with Netherlands looking for a win against Tunisia and Japan taking on a Sweden side that had won 5-1 against the Tunisians, but lost to the Dutch by the same scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Group A/B/C/D/F Third PlaceGermany v Group A/B/C/D/F third-placed team (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Boston Stadium in the USA. Germany thrashed Curaçao 7-1 and then came from behind to edge out Ivory Coast to secure their place as Group E winners. It might be expected for the third-placed qualifiers to struggle in this round, but the last two times the format allowed some of the teams finishing in third to reach the knockout stage were in the 24-team tournaments of 1990 and 1994, and on those occasions, Argentina and Italy respectively made it all the way to the final after progressing from outside the top two.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Christopher's ChoiceWhen Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E2Tom Allen presents another collection of outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. Featuring clips of Ant and Dec, Ralf Little, Jill Scott, Ricky Tomlinson, Prue Leith, Warwick Davis and many more, with the cock-ups including Bradley Walsh falling over during a recording of Blankety Blank.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group F Winner v Group C Runner-UpGroup F winner v Group C runner-up (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. Japan and the Netherlands were both well positioned to advance from Group F, sitting on four points after everyone had played two matches, with matches against Sweden and already-eliminated Tunisia respectively to come. Group C also looked a difficult one to call, with Scotland, Morocco and Brazil all putting themselves in contention to advance after two rounds of fixtures.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E3Kelvin takes his son Milo on an adventure to his first cattle market, while the pigs run amok as they are being moved into the woodland. Liz channels her inner shepherdess as she single-handedly delivers a lamb, while the twins celebrate their first birthday, but an escapee sheep means dinner is on hold.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group I Winner v Group C/D/F/G/H Third PlaceGroup I winner v Group C/D/F/G/H third-placed team (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. France were the pre-tournament favourites to top Group I, and they won their opening two matches 3-1 against Senegal and Iraq. However, Norway also had six points from their first two games and will have pipped the French to top spot should they have defeated them. Whoever won the group will fancy their chances against whichever third-place team they face, but can take nothing for granted in a competition in which many upsets have occurred over the years.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: S1 E4Stephen Mangan hosts the game show, with Jonathan and Helen joining captains Daisy May Cooper and Alan Carr to try to guess mystery passwords across multiple rounds as they try to win £10,000.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Mexico v Group C/E/F/H/I Third PlaceMexico v Group C/E/F/H/I third-placed team (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Mexico City Stadium. Co-hosts Mexico beat South Africa, South Korea and Czechia in their Group A matches, without conceding a goal, and have an outstanding record here in their spiritual home. There is a scenario would see the Mexicans on a collision course with England, should Thomas Tuchel's men top their group and progress to the last 16, but Mexico will simply be focused on victory here first, against a third-placed qualifier.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Craig and DoriStephen Mulhern hosts a look back at some of the most fearsome battles between hopeful players and the cruel Banker. This time he revisits Craig and Dori's games. Do they choose the right boxes and head home with a fortune, or does the Banker tempt them out of the game with a cunning offer.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Los AngelesJames enters the Los Angeles in style while driving a vintage Porsche. After a visit to an incredible food market in Santa Monica, he heads to the beach to cook up a storm. He also meets a pensioner who happens to be a fitness coach, drops in on old friend and chef-to-the-stars Wolfgang Puck at his Beverly Hills restaurant CUT and finishes his visit with a bite of his favourite pizza.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group E Runner-Up v Group I Runner-UpGroup E runner-up v Group I runner-up (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group I Winner v Group C/D/F/G/H Third PlaceGroup I winner v Group C/D/F/G/H third-placed team (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. France were the pre-tournament favourites to top Group I, and they won their opening two matches 3-1 against Senegal and Iraq. However, Norway also had six points from their first two games and will have pipped the French to top spot should they have defeated them. Whoever won the group will fancy their chances against whichever third-place team they face, but can take nothing for granted in a competition in which many upsets have occurred over the years.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Mexico v Group C/E/F/H/I Third PlaceMexico v Group C/E/F/H/I third-placed team (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Mexico City Stadium. Co-hosts Mexico beat South Africa, South Korea and Czechia in their Group A matches, without conceding a goal, and have an outstanding record here in their spiritual home. There is a scenario would see the Mexicans on a collision course with England, should Thomas Tuchel's men top their group and progress to the last 16, but Mexico will simply be focused on victory here first, against a third-placed qualifier.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Craig and DoriStephen Mulhern hosts a look back at some of the most fearsome battles between hopeful players and the cruel Banker. programme.desc: S1 E6 — Los AngelesJames enters the Los Angeles in style while driving a vintage Porsche. After a visit to an incredible food market in Santa Monica, he heads to the beach to cook up a storm. He also meets a pensioner who happens to be a fitness coach, drops in on old friend and chef-to-the-stars Wolfgang Puck at his Beverly Hills restaurant CUT and finishes his visit with a bite of his favourite pizza.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S16 E4 — PeterboroughDavid Dickinson and the team visit Peterborough, where James Layte has a spooky encounter with a wax mask and a wind-up toy lion gives the host the fright of his life.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E7 — SandraIt's Sandra's turn to take on the Banker - join Stephen Mulhern to find out if she takes home a huge cash prize or becomes the latest member of the 1p Club.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E18Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group C Winner v Group F Runner-UpGroup C winner v Group F runner-up (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Houston Stadium in the USA. Who tops Group C will have been decided by goal difference should Brazil and Morocco have defeated Scotland and Haiti respectively. It was the same situation in Group F with Netherlands looking for a win against Tunisia and Japan taking on a Sweden side that had won 5-1 against the Tunisians, but lost to the Dutch by the same scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Group A/B/C/D/F Third PlaceGermany v Group A/B/C/D/F third-placed team (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Boston Stadium in the USA. Germany thrashed Curaçao 7-1 and then came from behind to edge out Ivory Coast to secure their place as Group E winners. It might be expected for the third-placed qualifiers to struggle in this round, but the last two times the format allowed some of the teams finishing in third to reach the knockout stage were in the 24-team tournaments of 1990 and 1994, and on those occasions, Argentina and Italy respectively made it all the way to the final after progressing from outside the top two.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Christopher's ChoiceWhen Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E2Tom Allen presents another collection of outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. Featuring clips of Ant and Dec, Ralf Little, Jill Scott, Ricky Tomlinson, Prue Leith, Warwick Davis and many more, with the cock-ups including Bradley Walsh falling over during a recording of Blankety Blank.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group F Winner v Group C Runner-UpGroup F winner v Group C runner-up (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. Japan and the Netherlands were both well positioned to advance from Group F, sitting on four points after everyone had played two matches, with matches against Sweden and already-eliminated Tunisia respectively to come. Group C also looked a difficult one to call, with Scotland, Morocco and Brazil all putting themselves in contention to advance after two rounds of fixtures.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E3Kelvin takes his son Milo on an adventure to his first cattle market, while the pigs run amok as they are being moved into the woodland. Liz channels her inner shepherdess as she single-handedly delivers a lamb, while the twins celebrate their first birthday, but an escapee sheep means dinner is on hold.

It might be expected for the third-placed qualifiers to struggle in this round, but the last two times the format allowed some of the teams finishing in third to reach the knockout stage were in the 24-team tournaments of 1990 and 1994, and on those occasions, Argentina and Italy respectively made it all the way to the final after progressing from outside the top two.

programme.desc: S13 E18Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group C Winner v Group F Runner-UpGroup C winner v Group F runner-up (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Houston Stadium in the USA. Who tops Group C will have been decided by goal difference should Brazil and Morocco have defeated Scotland and Haiti respectively. It was the same situation in Group F with Netherlands looking for a win against Tunisia and Japan taking on a Sweden side that had won 5-1 against the Tunisians, but lost to the Dutch by the same scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Group A/B/C/D/F Third PlaceGermany v Group A/B/C/D/F third-placed team (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Boston Stadium in the USA. Germany thrashed Curaçao 7-1 and then came from behind to edge out Ivory Coast to secure their place as Group E winners. It might be expected for the third-placed qualifiers to struggle in this round, but the last two times the format allowed some of the teams finishing in third to reach the knockout stage were in the 24-team tournaments of 1990 and 1994, and on those occasions, Argentina and Italy respectively made it all the way to the final after progressing from outside the top two.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Christopher's ChoiceWhen Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E2Tom Allen presents another collection of outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. Featuring clips of Ant and Dec, Ralf Little, Jill Scott, Ricky Tomlinson, Prue Leith, Warwick Davis and many more, with the cock-ups including Bradley Walsh falling over during a recording of Blankety Blank.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group F Winner v Group C Runner-UpGroup F winner v Group C runner-up (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. Japan and the Netherlands were both well positioned to advance from Group F, sitting on four points after everyone had played two matches, with matches against Sweden and already-eliminated Tunisia respectively to come. Group C also looked a difficult one to call, with Scotland, Morocco and Brazil all putting themselves in contention to advance after two rounds of fixtures.

programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group I Winner v Group C/D/F/G/H Third PlaceGroup I winner v Group C/D/F/G/H third-placed team (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. France were the pre-tournament favourites to top Group I, and they won their opening two matches 3-1 against Senegal and Iraq. However, Norway also had six points from their first two games and will have pipped the French to top spot should they have defeated them. Whoever won the group will fancy their chances against whichever third-place team they face, but can take nothing for granted in a competition in which many upsets have occurred over the years.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Mexico v Group C/E/F/H/I Third PlaceMexico v Group C/E/F/H/I third-placed team (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Mexico City Stadium. Co-hosts Mexico beat South Africa, South Korea and Czechia in their Group A matches, without conceding a goal, and have an outstanding record here in their spiritual home. There is a scenario would see the Mexicans on a collision course with England, should Thomas Tuchel's men top their group and progress to the last 16, but Mexico will simply be focused on victory here first, against a third-placed qualifier.

programme.desc: S13 E18Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group C Winner v Group F Runner-UpGroup C winner v Group F runner-up (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Houston Stadium in the USA. Who tops Group C will have been decided by goal difference should Brazil and Morocco have defeated Scotland and Haiti respectively. It was the same situation in Group F with Netherlands looking for a win against Tunisia and Japan taking on a Sweden side that had won 5-1 against the Tunisians, but lost to the Dutch by the same scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Group A/B/C/D/F Third PlaceGermany v Group A/B/C/D/F third-placed team (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Boston Stadium in the USA. Germany thrashed Curaçao 7-1 and then came from behind to edge out Ivory Coast to secure their place as Group E winners. It might be expected for the third-placed qualifiers to struggle in this round, but the last two times the format allowed some of the teams finishing in third to reach the knockout stage were in the 24-team tournaments of 1990 and 1994, and on those occasions, Argentina and Italy respectively made it all the way to the final after progressing from outside the top two.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Christopher's ChoiceWhen Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E2Tom Allen presents another collection of outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. Featuring clips of Ant and Dec, Ralf Little, Jill Scott, Ricky Tomlinson, Prue Leith, Warwick Davis and many more, with the cock-ups including Bradley Walsh falling over during a recording of Blankety Blank.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group F Winner v Group C Runner-UpGroup F winner v Group C runner-up (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. Japan and the Netherlands were both well positioned to advance from Group F, sitting on four points after everyone had played two matches, with matches against Sweden and already-eliminated Tunisia respectively to come. Group C also looked a difficult one to call, with Scotland, Morocco and Brazil all putting themselves in contention to advance after two rounds of fixtures.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group I Winner v Group C/D/F/G/H Third PlaceGroup I winner v Group C/D/F/G/H third-placed team (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. France were the pre-tournament favourites to top Group I, and they won their opening two matches 3-1 against Senegal and Iraq. However, Norway also had six points from their first two games and will have pipped the French to top spot should they have defeated them. programme.desc: Mexico v Group C/E/F/H/I Third PlaceMexico v Group C/E/F/H/I third-placed team (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Mexico City Stadium. Co-hosts Mexico beat South Africa, South Korea and Czechia in their Group A matches, without conceding a goal, and have an outstanding record here in their spiritual home. There is a scenario would see the Mexicans on a collision course with England, should Thomas Tuchel's men top their group and progress to the last 16, but Mexico will simply be focused on victory here first, against a third-placed qualifier.

Coverage of the round-of-32 match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. France were the pre-tournament favourites to top Group I, and they won their opening two matches 3-1 against Senegal and Iraq. However, Norway also had six points from their first two games and will have pipped the French to top spot should they have defeated them. Whoever won the group will fancy their chances against whichever third-place team they face, but can take nothing for granted in a competition in which many upsets have occurred over the years.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: S1 E4Stephen Mangan hosts the game show, with Jonathan and Helen joining captains Daisy May Cooper and Alan Carr to try to guess mystery passwords across multiple rounds as they try to win £10,000.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Mexico v Group C/E/F/H/I Third PlaceMexico v Group C/E/F/H/I third-placed team (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Mexico City Stadium. Co-hosts Mexico beat South Africa, South Korea and Czechia in their Group A matches, without conceding a goal, and have an outstanding record here in their spiritual home. There is a scenario would see the Mexicans on a collision course with England, should Thomas Tuchel's men top their group and progress to the last 16, but Mexico will simply be focused on victory here first, against a third-placed qualifier.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Los AngelesJames enters the Los Angeles in style while driving a vintage Porsche. programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E7 — SandraIt's Sandra's turn to take on the Banker - join Stephen Mulhern to find out if she takes home a huge cash prize or becomes the latest member of the 1p Club.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E18Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group C Winner v Group F Runner-UpGroup C winner v Group F runner-up (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Houston Stadium in the USA. Who tops Group C will have been decided by goal difference should Brazil and Morocco have defeated Scotland and Haiti respectively. It was the same situation in Group F with Netherlands looking for a win against Tunisia and Japan taking on a Sweden side that had won 5-1 against the Tunisians, but lost to the Dutch by the same scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Group A/B/C/D/F Third PlaceGermany v Group A/B/C/D/F third-placed team (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Boston Stadium in the USA. Germany thrashed Curaçao 7-1 and then came from behind to edge out Ivory Coast to secure their place as Group E winners. It might be expected for the third-placed qualifiers to struggle in this round, but the last two times the format allowed some of the teams finishing in third to reach the knockout stage were in the 24-team tournaments of 1990 and 1994, and on those occasions, Argentina and Italy respectively made it all the way to the final after progressing from outside the top two.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Christopher's ChoiceWhen Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E2Tom Allen presents another collection of outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. Featuring clips of Ant and Dec, Ralf Little, Jill Scott, Ricky Tomlinson, Prue Leith, Warwick Davis and many more, with the cock-ups including Bradley Walsh falling over during a recording of Blankety Blank.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group F Winner v Group C Runner-UpGroup F winner v Group C runner-up (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Monterrey Stadium in Mexico. Japan and the Netherlands were both well positioned to advance from Group F, sitting on four points after everyone had played two matches, with matches against Sweden and already-eliminated Tunisia respectively to come. Group C also looked a difficult one to call, with Scotland, Morocco and Brazil all putting themselves in contention to advance after two rounds of fixtures.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E9Adil Ray hosts as tennis coach Judy Murray and sports presenter Mark Pougatch take on Morning Live hosts Helen Skelton and Rav Wilding to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S1 E3Kelvin takes his son Milo on an adventure to his first cattle market, while the pigs run amok as they are being moved into the woodland. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Group C Winner v Group F Runner-UpGroup C winner v Group F runner-up (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Houston Stadium in the USA. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Germany v Group A/B/C/D/F Third PlaceGermany v Group A/B/C/D/F third-placed team (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Boston Stadium in the USA. Germany thrashed Curaçao 7-1 and then came from behind to edge out Ivory Coast to secure their place as Group E winners. It might be expected for the third-placed qualifiers to struggle in this round, but the last two times the format allowed some of the teams finishing in third to reach the knockout stage were in the 24-team tournaments of 1990 and 1994, and on those occasions, Argentina and Italy respectively made it all the way to the final after progressing from outside the top two.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Christopher's ChoiceWhen Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E2Tom Allen presents another collection of outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: E6Runes are the letters of an ancient Germanic writing system that harkens back to a mythological age filled with heroes, magic, and mystery.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E6Hitler’s last soldier in America who defied the FBI for 40 years, the Auschwitz prisoners who releaved the secrets of the death camps, and the merciless Nazi who almost got away.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E3A chronological telling of the dramatic D-Day story, focusing on vessels that made the landings possible. From the X-Craft lying on the seabed days before the invasion to battleships like USS Texas and HMS Belfast that bombarded the Normandy beaches.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: E6Runes are the letters of an ancient Germanic writing system that harkens back to a mythological age filled with heroes, magic, and mystery.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E1In 1944, 28 Greek socialists were shot in Syntagma Square and 100,000 had perished by the end of the Civil War. Was this the old order Winston Churchill had longed for?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E2Since the Syrian civil war broke out in 2011, 400,000 have been killed in the conflict. Who is to blame for this and the terrible conditions in which its people live?

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E3Examining the machines used by iconic military unit 'The Desert Rats' in the North African desert campaign of World War II.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E4We examine the robot that defused bombs both on foreign battlefields and British streets, and an astonishing Gulf War minelayer.

programme.title: Shadow Man

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E9The decision by Hitler to send his armies east in to Russia was probably the most significant of the war. Now against military convention, he was fighting on two fronts and almost as bad made a bitter enemy of an erstwhile ally.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E10And so it finally arrived: 6th June 1944, the day that British, US and Canadian troops were sent across the English Channel to begin the job of reclaiming continental Europe and freeing it from German occupation.

programme.desc: E1Frenchman Fred Sirieix joins Al Murray to break down what really happened during the Napoleonic wars. Did Britain really win the battle of Waterloo?

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6We explore two submarines – former Cold War enemies now moored in a Kent river, and discover the story of Vasili Arkhipov, a Soviet submariner who refused to authorise a nuclear launch.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5Exploring the machines that hide in the shadows, capturing, transmitting and analysing vital combat information.

programme.title: Combat Machines

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E4Cataloguing the many lovers of the Nazi dictator, and charting the unfortunate demise of all who dared resist his love, affection and sexual appetite.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7We tell the story of two rescues that ended in tragedy – the sinking of the hospital ship Britannic, and the Lancastria, rescuing soldiers and civilians from France in 1940. In the 19th century, USS Constellation chased down slave ships.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E1Albert Speer was Hitler’s favorite architect and a central figure within the Führer’s inner circle. Speer’s buildings helped cement Hitler’s position and push Germany towards war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
